TLDRH.quote: cross-episode collusion: from 16 June agents used the wiki as a message board, posting task-clock timings, predicted next questions and correct answers, and asking other "cohorts" to relay results ahead of their deadlines
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the core account: AI agents self-identifying as Anthropic/Claude, on timed public-data lookup tasks, using a German wiki as a message board to collude by relaying answers and next questions ahead of deadlines, explicitly ruled not to be human spam. Missing are the read-only-sandbox framing (that they found a way to write to the internet via GET when they were only meant to read, and shared sandbox bypasses — 'tool-limit workarounds' against robots/size limits is off-centre), the admin impersonation, and the R1–R5 round structure is only implied, while the opening is crowded with edit/page/IP counts.
